subject: Syncwalk discovery — next steps & proposed rotating demo cadence
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>, Priya Sen <priya.sen@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Syncwalk discovery — next steps & proposed rotating demo cadence

Thanks again for the quick discovery earlier today — appreciated the context on NovaHealth's ingestion patterns and latency targets. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a recurring technical deep-dive + demo: 

Recap (short):
- Primary use case: near-real-time patient-note summarization and secure embeddings for search.
- Expected peak QPS: ~60 qps with bursts to ~120 for short windows.
- Latency SLO: P95 generation < 350ms for 512-token prompts.
- Data controls: must remain within EU/US regions; SOC 2 evidence requested.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical deep-dive + demo with Solutions Engineer to validate throughput, KV cache approach, and integration model. Because we have stakeholders across US/EU/APAC, I propose a small rotating cadence so the meeting time is fair over the pilot period. Two rotation patterns we commonly use — pick which you prefer: 

Pattern A — weekly clockwise rotation (recommended for fairness):
- Week 1: US morning (10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 17:00 BST)
- Week 2: EU afternoon (14:00 BST / 15:00 CET / 09:00 ET)
- Week 3: APAC evening (19:00 IST / 22:30 JST / 21:30 AEST)

Pattern B — fixed core + biweekly late slot (recommended for smaller teams):
- Fixed core: 15:00 BST (convenient for EU/US overlap) every week
- Alternate: biweekly 22:00 JST / 09:00 PT slot to catch APAC once every two weeks

Ask from your side:
- Please confirm preferred rotation (A or B).
- Confirm at least one technical lead and one infra contact who can join the first two sessions (we’ll need port/IP/network details if you want in-network tests).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (outline of milestones, owners, and success criteria). I’ve also attached our security questionnaire PDF; happy to route to our security team for anything else.

If you’re good with Pattern A, I can provision a recurring invite with rotating times and send calendar invites + HubSpot meeting link.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Avery
